title: Definition and runtime state were ambiguous
impact: Builders and controllers could interpret the same status differently.
recommended_action: Separate definition_status, runtime_state, evidence_result, and program_verdict.

title: Authorization lacked executable subset proof
impact: A runtime contract could request actions not granted by the Blueprint.
recommended_action: Intersect all authority layers and reject runtime widening.

title: Task and wave sequencing were partly documentation-only
impact: A successor wave could be admitted before predecessor completion.
recommended_action: Enforce task DAG, wave dependencies, entry gates, and exit gates at admission.

title: Runtime-to-governance return channel was informal
impact: Controller results could be mistaken for a final program verdict.
recommended_action: Export a digest-bound Handoff Receipt and reserve terminal acceptance for the program owner.

title: Host-specific adapters remain outside the universal pair
impact: External workers and remote actions require an additional adapter.
recommended_action: Add replaceable adapters only when a concrete host and authority model are selected.
